scope_requirement.rule: Economic scale is a data property, not an engine mode. One engine must compose nested and linked markets from settlement/local scale through continental, planetary, multi-world and multiversal/cross-reality trade networks.
required_behaviors: stable versioned EconomicScope identities with optional parent inheritance
explicit trade links/routes instead of assuming all scopes are connected
scope-specific currencies conversion policies prices scarcity availability legality taxes tariffs and fees where governed by definitions
local overrides of parent or wider-scope defaults
cross-scope price and settlement calculation bound to exact scope and policy versions
cross-reality exchange only through explicitly allowed route/policy chains
fail-closed behavior for disconnected embargoed unauthorized or stale routes/scopes
replay-safe and idempotent settlement regardless of economic scale

Provide version-safe in-game currency/material budget and cost summaries without granting APM automation authority.

Provide deterministic cross-scope currency conversion price availability tariff/fee/restriction and route-policy hooks when those rules are defined.
Provide a no-AI deterministic path and keep real-money/payment integration absent.
Do not implement the later CEL life-loop, market cadence or automation controller inside MIB-13; only provide the economy primitives/interfaces CEL will consume.
